theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_orthogonal_coordinates
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ∃ v : Euclid n, ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) ∧ ∀ (v : Euclid n) (w : Euclid k), ‖ι v + ι' w‖ ^ 2 = ‖v‖ ^ 2 + ‖w‖ ^ 2
